messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU_CLUSTER_SATURATION detected — queue growth > 95th percentile, 429s increasing across hotpath pools. Pager triggered.
Jamie (oncall): seeing ~12k queued requests on hotpool-gpu-1, spikes started ~5m ago. Customers 3/priority-high showing elevated 429s.
Sasha (eng): confirmed in dashboards — per-route latency + error% for model/text-gen-large. Token buckets showing regen lag on tier=standard.
Devon (infra-oncall): on it. checking autoscaler status and pool health. any recent deploys? @deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: No deploys in last 30m. Canary jobs stable.
Matt (runtime): dumping queue metrics now. here are the top lines:
```
hotpool-gpu-1 queued: 12134
hotpool-gpu-1 active gpus: 48 (cap=50)
autoscaler: desired=62, current=48, max_allowed=60
tokenbucket.standard.available_units: 0
tokenbucket.standard.last_regen: 32s ago
429 rate: 18% -> 24% last 5m
```
Jamie (oncall): autoscaler desired > current but max_allowed=60 prevents scale up. that explains stalled scale.
Sasha (eng): looks like someone lowered pool max in last 6h (maybe config rollback). changing max_allowed to 80 should let desired 62 succeed. I'll push change to infra-config.
Devon (infra-oncall): I can patch the autoscaler now. doing patch: `kubectl -n infra patch config autoscaler --type merge -p '{"spec":{"maxNodes":80}}'`
Matt (runtime): while autoscaler catches up, we should reduce token burn and add short-term routing fallback to cpu-variant for non-critical routes. also consider increasing tokenbucket regen to reduce head-of-queue stalls.
Sasha (eng): agreed. Proposed quick mitigations: 1) bump autoscaler max to 80 (Devon). 2) increase tokenbucket.regen_rate for tier=standard from 100u/s -> 300u/s (temporary). 3) route `low-priority` and `bulk-embed` to cpu pool. 4) enable immediate hotpath fallback to model-v2-small for best-effort customers.
Luis (support): list of impacted customers: AcmeAnalytics (high), NotesFlow (med), ChatPro (high). Acme has open support ticket complaining about 429s on ingest.
Jamie (oncall): I'm starting the handoff to infra and runtime. tagging incident oncall rotation. @Devon you own infra changes, @Matt you own routing/token changes, @Sasha lead rollback/validation.
Devon (infra-oncall): autoscaler patch applied. new maxNodes=80. watch desired->current.
Matt (runtime): patching tokenbucket:
```
PATCH /api/v1/config/tokenbucket
{ "tier": "standard", "regen_rate": 300 }
```
Matt (runtime): temporarily enabled route override: `route.low-priority -> cpu-pool` and `route.bulk-embed -> cpu-pool` (will revert after stable).
Sasha (eng): validating. traffic is rerouting. queue for hotpool-gpu-1 dropping: 12k -> 7.2k -> 2.1k in 8m. 429 rate falling to 6%.
Luis (support): AcmeAnalytics reports partial recovery, still seeing intermittent errors but much better.
Jamie (oncall): excellent. estimate full drain in ~6m. marking customer impact: degraded for 18m so far. potential SLO window: 00:28–00:46 UTC.
Devon (infra-oncall): autoscaler current nodes=64, desired=64, scaling up in progress to new desired. GPU pool health ok, no OOMs.
Matt (runtime): follow-up: we observed tokenbucket.available_units hitting zero because per-tenant burst caps were too low relative to surge. we'll open a postmortem to revisit default regen and tier mapping.
Sasha (eng): action items for immediate incident close: 
- revert route overrides after drain (Matt)
- keep autoscaler max=80 but audit why it was lowered (Devon)
- run capacity test to validate new regen setting (Sasha/Matt)

Jamie (oncall): customer impact summary for ops: 
- Affected customers: AcmeAnalytics (high), ChatPro (high), NotesFlow (medium)
- Symptom: 429s and increased latencies on GPU hotpath routes
- Duration: ~18 minutes degraded, peak queue ~12k, peak 429 rate 24%
- Mitigations taken: increased autoscaler max, increased tokenbucket regen, rerouted low-priority to cpu pool, enabled model fallback for best-effort traffic.

Luis (support): I'll update the tickets and flag for account escalation for AcmeAnalytics (they are enterprise).
Sasha (eng): post-incident plan:
- revert temporary regen bump to a measured staged rollout with canary tests.
- add alert: tokenbucket.available_units < 10% AND autoscaler.desired > autoscaler.max -> critical pager (so we catch config limits earlier).
- add runbook step to prioritize increasing autoscaler max before token tuning.

Jamie (oncall): incident STATUS: mitigated — queue draining, 429s returning toward baseline. keeping this thread open for 30m to monitor.
Matt (runtime): note: there was a latent config change earlier this morning that lowered `maxNodes` from 120 -> 60 during a cost-sweep PR. we'll surface that in postmortem.
Devon (infra-oncall): logged infra change and rollback author. scheduling quick follow-up with infra owners.
Jamie (oncall): thanks all. final note: if any customer shows regressions after revert, escalate back into this thread. closing handoff to postmortem owners: Sasha + Matt + Devon.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: GPU_CLUSTER_SATURATION status changed to MITIGATED by Jamie (oncall).
